primaryReplacement.roleRationale: Howden handled the final 30 defensive snaps when starting safety Reid left, following Reid’s initial 34. The safety assignment was additional to Howden’s existing special-teams role; no displacement of that special-teams duty is reported. Do not reallocate Sanker or Blackmon baseline work.
